Layout.description: An AI-driven platform for learning a foreign language: lessons, graded answers, and automatic levelling.

HomePage.headline: Learn a language with a tutor that adapts to you!
HomePage.intro: ft_transcendence teaches you through lessons, grades your answers, and tracks the level it infers from them.

Placement.title: Placement test
Placement.startDescription: Questions on vocabulary, grammar and reading in {language}. The test adapts to your answers and stops as soon as it knows your level. Each question is timed.

Lesson.leaveConfirm: Leave the exam? The timer of this page keeps running. If it runs out, the page counts as unanswered.

Lesson.timeRanOut: Time ran out while you were away. This page counts as unanswered.
